item.title: Manitoba Music Export at Folk Canada: Keri Latimer, Sam Singer, Two Crows For Comfort, Jacob Brodovsky, Dominique Adams, KC Is Lazy
item.description:
16 Oct 26

Venue

Sheraton Hamilton Hotel, Ballroom, 2nd Floor
116 King St W
Winnipeg

Promoters

  • Manitoba Music
  • Folk Canada

Daytime Spotlight Showcase

Manitoba Music is excited to partner with Folk Canada Conference, the premiere networking event for the Canadian folk/roots music communities, to present a Daytime Spotlight Showcase! Six stellar artists from Manitoba will share their music at during 15-minute slots at the 2nd floor Ballroom at the host hotel (Sheraton Hamilton Hotel), including theremin maven Keri Latimer, indie folk act Sam Singer & The Beautiful Movers, folk duo Two Crows for Comfort, indie folk singer/songwriter Jacob Brodovsky, contemporary folk artist Dominique Adams, and German-born Manitoba-based singer/songwriter KC Is Lazy. 

SCHEDULE

1:30 PM Keri Latimer

item.title: send + receive v28: Abstract Turntablism Workshop : Maria Chavez
item.description:
16 Oct 26

Venue

Video Pool Media Arts Centre
100 Arthur Street, 2nd Floor

A hands-on workshop by Maria Chavez, using turntables and vinyl records as an instrument at Video Pool Media Arts Centre.

Maria Chavez leads a hands-on workshop using turntables and vinyl records as an instrument at Video Pool Media Arts Centre.

All participants will receive a free .PDF of Maria’s book, 'Of Technique: Chance Procedures on Turntable,' and learn basic abstract turntablism techniques.

There are limited spots for this interactive workshop, as we want everyone to have a chance to experiment with a turntable. Register today!

item.title: Erin Propp Album Release: Erin Propp
item.description:
16 Oct 26

Venue

Cornerstone
300 Hugo St N.
Winnipeg

Promoters

  • Birthday Cake Media

Two nights to celebrate The Longing Years, Erin Propp's first full-length album as a leader, out October 2, 2026.

Erin is a Juno-nominated, WCMA-winning vocalist and pianist and a mainstay of the Manitoba music scene, known for her interpretation of melody within the jazz genre and for her empathy-laden lyrics. The album features Joey Landreth, Fabio Ragnelli, Julian Bradford, and the Grammy-winning Attacca Quartet.

On stage: Erin Propp, Fabio Ragnelli, Julian Bradford, Joey Landreth.

Friday, October 16 (SOLD OUT) and Saturday, October 17, 2026, at Cornerstone. Rush seating, 100 seats per night. 7:00PM Doors Open, 7:30PM Show Starts.
